articles.title_en: A Comment on “Testing Models of Social Learning on Networks: Evidence From Two Experiments”
articles.title_cn: 对“网络社会学习模型检验：来自两个实验的证据”的评论
articles.abstract_en: Proposition 2 in Chandrasekhar et al. (2020) characterizes when imitation is optimal in a discrete-time setup where all agents are myopic Bayesian and this is common knowledge. In this note, we provide a correction to this result, where the condition for imitation to be optimal is stronger than in the original result.
articles.abstract_cn: Chandrasekhar等人（2020）中的命题2刻画了在离散时间设定下模仿何时是最优的，其中所有代理人都是短视贝叶斯且这是共同知识。在本注释中，我们对该结果进行了修正，其中模仿最优的条件比原始结果中的条件更强。

articles.abstract_en: We ask how fiscal deficits are financed in environments with two key features: (i) nominal rigidity, and (ii) a violation of Ricardian equivalence due to finite lives or liquidity constraints. In such environments, deficits can contribute to their own financing through two channels: a boom in real economic activity, which expands the tax base; and a surge in inflation, which erodes the real value of nominal government debt. Our main theoretical result establishes that this mechanism becomes more potent as fiscal adjustment is delayed, leading to full self‐financing in the limit: if the monetary authority does not lean too heavily against the fiscal stimulus, then the government can run a deficit today, refrain from tax hikes or spending cuts in the future, and still see its debt converge back to its initial level. We further demonstrate that a significant degree of self‐financing is achievable when the theory is disciplined by empirical evidence on marginal propensities to consume, nominal rigidities, the monetary policy reaction, and the speed of fiscal adjustment.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们探讨在具有两个关键特征的环境中财政赤字如何融资：（i）名义刚性，以及（ii）由于有限生命或流动性约束导致的李嘉图等价失效。在这样的环境中，赤字可以通过两个渠道为其自身融资做出贡献：实际经济活动的繁荣，扩大了税基；以及通胀的飙升，侵蚀了名义政府债务的实际价值。我们的主要理论结果确立了这一机制随着财政调整的延迟而变得更加有力，最终在极限情况下实现完全自我融资：如果货币当局不过度抵制财政刺激，那么政府今天可以运行赤字，未来避免增税或削减支出，而其债务仍能收敛回初始水平。我们进一步证明，当理论受到关于边际消费倾向、名义刚性、货币政策反应以及财政调整速度的经验证据约束时，可以实现显著的自我融资程度。

articles.title_en: On the Structure of Informationally Robust Optimal Mechanisms
articles.title_cn: 关于信息稳健最优机制的结构
articles.abstract_en: We study the design of optimal mechanisms when the designer is uncertain both about the form of information held by the agents and also about which equilibrium will be played. The guarantee of a mechanism is its worst performance across all information structures and equilibria. The potential of an information structure is its best performance across all mechanisms and equilibria. We formulate a pair of linear programs, one of which is a lower bound on the maximum guarantee across all mechanisms, and the other of which is an upper bound on the minimum potential across all information structures. In applications to public expenditure, bilateral trade, and optimal auctions, we use the bounding programs to characterize guarantee‐maximizing mechanisms and potential‐minimizing information structures and show that the max guarantee is equal to the min potential.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究当设计者既不确定代理人持有的信息形式，也不确定将进行哪种均衡时，最优机制的设计。机制的保证是其在所有信息结构和均衡中的最差表现。信息结构的潜力是其在所有机制和均衡中的最佳表现。我们提出一对线性规划，其中一个是对所有机制中最大保证的下界，另一个是对所有信息结构中最小潜力的上界。在公共支出、双边贸易和最优拍卖的应用中，我们使用边界规划来刻画保证最大化的机制和潜力最小化的信息结构，并表明最大保证等于最小潜力。

articles.title_en: The Rise of Fiscal Capacity: Administration and State Consolidation in the Holy Roman Empire
articles.title_cn: 财政能力的崛起：神圣罗马帝国的行政与国家整合
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies the role of fiscal capacity in European state consolidation. Our analysis is organized around novel data on the territories and cities of the Holy Roman Empire in the early modern period. Territories implementing an early fiscal reform were more likely to survive, increased in size, and achieved a more compact extent. We provide evidence for the causal interpretation of these results and show key mechanisms: revenues, military investments, and marriage success. The imposition of Imperial taxes, quasi‐random in timing and size, increased the benefits of an efficient tax administration on the side of rulers, driving the implementation of fiscal centralization. Within territories, Chambers became the dominant administrative institution, tilting the consolidating states toward absolutism.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了财政能力在欧洲国家整合中的作用。我们的分析围绕近代早期神圣罗马帝国领土和城市的新数据展开。实施早期财政改革的领土更有可能存续，规模扩大，并实现更紧凑的版图。我们为这些结果的因果解释提供了证据，并展示了关键机制：收入、军事投资和婚姻成功。帝国税收的征收，其时间和规模近似随机，增加了统治者一方高效税收行政的收益，推动了财政中央集权的实施。在领土内部，议会（Chambers）成为主导的行政机构，使整合中的国家倾向于专制主义。

articles.title_en: Historical Self‐Governance and Norms of Cooperation
articles.abstract_en: Does self‐governance, a hallmark of democratic societies, foster norms of generalized cooperation? Does this effect persist, and if so, why? I investigate these questions using a natural experiment in Switzerland. In the Middle Ages, the absence of an heir resulted in the extinction of a prominent noble dynasty. As a result, some Swiss municipalities became self‐governing, whereas the others remained under feudalism for another 600 years. Evidence from a behavioral experiment, the World Values Survey and the Swiss Household Panel consistently show that individuals from historically self‐governing municipalities exhibit stronger norms of cooperation today. Referenda data on voter‐turnout allow me to trace these effects on individually costly and socially beneficial actions for over 150 years. Furthermore, norms of cooperation map into prosocial behaviors like charitable giving and environmental protection. Uniquely, Switzerland tracks every family's place of origin in registration data, which I use to demonstrate persistence from cultural transmission in a context of historically low migration.
articles.abstract_cn: 自治作为民主社会的标志，是否会促进普遍合作的规范？这种影响是否会持续存在，如果会，原因何在？我利用瑞士的一项自然实验来研究这些问题。在中世纪，由于没有继承人，一个显赫的贵族王朝灭绝了。结果，一些瑞士市镇实现了自治，而其他市镇则在封建制度下又延续了600年。来自行为实验、世界价值观调查和瑞士家庭面板数据的证据一致表明，来自历史上自治市镇的个人如今表现出更强的合作规范。关于选民投票率的公投数据使我能够追溯这些对个人有成本且对社会有益的行为的影响，时间跨度超过150年。此外，合作规范还映射到亲社会行为，如慈善捐赠和环境保护。瑞士独特地在登记数据中追踪每个家庭的出生地，我利用这一点来证明在历史上低迁移的背景下，文化传播的持续性。

articles.title_en: Exact Bias Correction for Linear Adjustment of Randomized Controlled Trials
articles.title_cn: 随机对照试验线性调整的精确偏差校正
articles.abstract_en: Freedman (2008a,b) showed that the linear regression estimator is biased for the analysis of randomized controlled trials under the randomization model. Under Freedman's assumptions, we derive exact closed‐form bias corrections for the linear regression estimator. We show that the limiting distribution of the bias corrected estimator is identical to the uncorrected estimator. Taken together with results from Lin (2013), our results show that Freedman's theoretical arguments against the use of regression adjustment can be resolved with minor modifications to practice.
articles.abstract_cn: Freedman (2008a,b) 表明，在随机化模型下，线性回归估计量用于分析随机对照试验时存在偏差。在 Freedman 的假设下，我们推导出线性回归估计量的精确闭式偏差校正。我们证明，偏差校正估计量的极限分布与未校正估计量相同。结合 Lin (2013) 的结果，我们的结果表明，Freedman 关于反对使用回归调整的理论论点可以通过对实践的微小修改来解决。

articles.abstract_en: Central banks wish to avoid self‐fulfilling fluctuations. Interest rate rules with a unit response to real rates achieve this under the weakest possible assumptions about the behavior of households and firms. They are robust to household heterogeneity, hand‐to‐mouth consumers, non‐rational household or firm expectations, active fiscal policy, and to any form of intertemporal or nominal‐real links. They are easy to employ in practice, using inflation‐protected bonds to infer real rates. With a time‐varying short‐term inflation target, they can implement an arbitrary inflation path, including optimal policy. This provides a way to translate policy makers' desired path for inflation into one for nominal rates. U.S. Federal Reserve behavior is remarkably close to that predicted by a real rate rule, given the desired inflation path of U.S. monetary policy makers. Real rate rules work thanks to the key role played by the Fisher equation in monetary transmission.
articles.abstract_cn: 中央银行希望避免自我实现的波动。对实际利率具有单位反应的利率规则在关于家庭和企业行为的最弱可能假设下实现了这一目标。它们对家庭异质性、手到嘴消费者、非理性家庭或企业预期、积极财政政策以及任何形式的跨期或名义-实际联系都具有稳健性。它们在实践中易于使用，利用通胀保值债券来推断实际利率。通过时变的短期通胀目标，它们可以实现任意通胀路径，包括最优政策。这提供了一种将政策制定者期望的通胀路径转化为名义利率路径的方法。鉴于美国货币政策制定者期望的通胀路径，美联储的行为与实际利率规则预测的非常接近。实际利率规则之所以有效，是因为费雪方程在货币传导中发挥了关键作用。

articles.title_en: Random Votes to Parties and Policies in Coalition Governments
articles.title_cn: 联盟政府中政党与政策的随机选票
articles.abstract_en: We exploit a natural experiment involving a randomization of votes across parties within coalitions in all local elections in Italy for over a decade. A lottery on the position of party symbols in the ballot papers allows estimating the causal effect of increasing votes to parties for coalition policies. A non‐marginal random boost of votes shifts budgetary spending towards the treated party's platform, but only for issues that are salient in that party's political manifesto. We study the chains of mechanisms mapping votes into policies and link it to an increase in bargaining power within legislative majorities. Parties leverage their higher electoral support to gain the appointment of politically affiliated cabinet members. Empowering different parties also leads to the selection of cabinets with different socio‐demographic characteristics. The unintentional experiment helps shed new light on mechanisms mapping votes to parties into coalition policies.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们利用一项自然实验，该实验涉及意大利所有地方选举中联盟内各政党选票的随机化，时间跨度超过十年。选票上政党符号位置的抽签使得我们能够估计增加政党选票对联盟政策的因果效应。选票的非边际随机增加会使预算支出偏向于受处理政党的纲领，但仅限于该政党政治宣言中突出的议题。我们研究了将选票转化为政策的机制链条，并将其与立法多数派内部谈判能力的增强联系起来。政党利用其更高的选举支持来获得政治关联内阁成员的任命。赋予不同政党权力也导致具有不同社会人口特征的内阁被选出。这一无意中的实验有助于为选票转化为联盟政策的机制提供新的见解。

articles.title_en: Propagation and Amplification of Local Productivity Spillovers
articles.title_cn: 地方生产率溢出效应的传播与放大
articles.abstract_en: The gains from agglomeration economies are believed to be highly localized. Using confidential Census plant‐level data, we show that large industrial plant openings raise the productivity not only of local plants but also of distant plants hundreds of miles away, which belong to large multi‐plant, multi‐region firms that are exposed to the local productivity spillover through one of their plants. This “global” productivity spillover does not decay with distance and is stronger if plants are in industries that share knowledge with each other. To quantify the significance of firms' plant‐level networks for the propagation and amplification of local productivity shocks, we estimate a quantitative spatial model in which plants of multi‐region firms are linked through shared knowledge. Counterfactual exercises show that while large industrial plant openings have a greater local impact in less developed regions, the aggregate gains are greatest when the plants locate in well‐developed regions, which are connected to other regions through firms' plant‐level (knowledge‐sharing) networks.
articles.abstract_cn: 集聚经济的收益被认为具有高度地方性。利用保密的普查工厂层面数据，我们表明大型工业工厂的开设不仅提高了当地工厂的生产率，还提高了数百英里之外遥远工厂的生产率，这些遥远工厂属于大型多工厂、多区域企业，通过其一家工厂接触到地方生产率溢出效应。这种“全球性”生产率溢出效应不随距离衰减，并且当工厂处于相互共享知识的行业时更为强烈。为了量化企业工厂层面网络对地方生产率冲击的传播和放大的重要性，我们估计了一个定量空间模型，在该模型中，多区域企业的工厂通过共享知识相互联系。反事实实验表明，虽然大型工业工厂的开设在欠发达地区具有更大的地方影响，但当工厂位于发达地区时，总体收益最大，因为这些地区通过企业的工厂层面（知识共享）网络与其他地区相连。

articles.title_en: Endogenous Production Networks Under Supply Chain Uncertainty
articles.title_cn: 供应链不确定性下的内生生产网络
articles.abstract_en: Supply chain disturbances can lead to substantial increases in production costs. To mitigate these risks, firms may take steps to reduce their reliance on volatile suppliers. We construct a model of endogenous network formation to investigate how these decisions affect the structure of the production network and the level and volatility of macroeconomic aggregates. When uncertainty increases in the model, producers prefer to purchase from more stable suppliers, even though they might sell at higher prices. The resulting reorganization of the network tends to reduce macroeconomic volatility, but at the cost of a decline in aggregate output. The model also predicts that more productive and stable firms have higher Domar weights—a measure of their importance as suppliers—in the equilibrium network. We provide a basic calibration of the model using U.S. data to evaluate the importance of these mechanisms.
articles.abstract_cn: 供应链扰动可能导致生产成本大幅增加。为减轻这些风险，企业可能采取措施减少对不稳定供应商的依赖。我们构建了一个内生网络形成模型，以研究这些决策如何影响生产网络的结构以及宏观经济总量的水平和波动性。当模型中的不确定性增加时，生产者更倾向于从更稳定的供应商处采购，即使这些供应商可能以更高的价格出售。由此产生的网络重组倾向于降低宏观经济波动性，但代价是总产出下降。该模型还预测，在生产率和稳定性方面更具优势的企业在均衡网络中具有更高的多马尔权重——这是衡量其作为供应商重要性的指标。我们使用美国数据对模型进行了基本校准，以评估这些机制的重要性。

articles.title_en: Spatial Unit Roots and Spurious Regression
articles.abstract_en: This paper proposes a model for, and investigates the consequences of, strong spatial dependence in economic variables. Our findings echo those of the corresponding “unit root” time series literature: Spatial unit root processes induce spuriously significant regression results, even with clustered standard errors or spatial HAC corrections. We develop large‐sample valid unit root and stationarity tests that can detect such strong spatial dependence. Finally, we use simulations to study strategies for valid inference in regressions with persistent spatial data, such as spatial analogues of first‐differencing transformations. Regressions from Chetty, Hendren, Kline, and Saez (2014) are used to illustrate the issues and methods.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文提出了一个模型，并研究了经济变量中强空间依赖性的后果。我们的发现与相应的“单位根”时间序列文献相呼应：空间单位根过程会导致伪显著的回归结果，即使使用聚类标准误或空间HAC修正也是如此。我们开发了大样本有效的单位根和平稳性检验，能够检测这种强空间依赖性。最后，我们使用模拟来研究在具有持久性空间数据的回归中进行有效推断的策略，例如空间一阶差分变换的类似物。Chetty、Hendren、Kline和Saez（2014）的回归被用来说明这些问题和方法。

articles.title_en: Lifestyle Behaviors and Wealth‐Health Gaps in Germany
articles.title_cn: 德国生活方式行为与财富-健康差距
articles.abstract_en: We document significant gaps in wealth across health status over the life cycle in Germany—a country with a universal healthcare system and negligible out‐of‐pocket medical expenses. To investigate the underlying sources of these wealth‐health gaps, we build a heterogeneous‐agent life‐cycle model in which health and wealth evolve endogenously. In the model, agents exert efforts to lead a healthy lifestyle, which helps maintain good health status in the future. Effort choices, or lifestyle behaviors, are subject to adjustment costs to capture their habitual nature in the data. We find that our estimated model generates the great majority of the empirical wealth gaps by health and quantify the role of earnings and savings channels through which health affects these gaps. We show that variations in individual health efforts account for around a quarter of the model‐generated wealth gaps by health, illustrating their role as an amplification mechanism behind the gaps.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们记录了德国生命周期中按健康状况划分的显著财富差距——德国是一个拥有全民医疗保健体系和可忽略不计的自付医疗费用的国家。为了调查这些财富-健康差距的根本来源，我们构建了一个异质性主体生命周期模型，其中健康和财富内生演化。在模型中，主体付出努力以过上健康的生活方式，这有助于在未来维持良好的健康状况。努力选择，或生活方式行为，受到调整成本的约束，以捕捉其在数据中的习惯性特征。我们发现，我们估计的模型产生了按健康划分的经验财富差距的绝大部分，并量化了健康通过这些差距影响的收入和储蓄渠道的作用。我们表明，个体健康努力的差异约占模型生成的按健康划分的财富差距的四分之一，说明它们作为差距背后的放大机制的作用。

articles.abstract_en: This paper develops a model of private bilateral contracting, in which an exogenous network determines the pairs of players who can communicate and contract with each other. After contracting, the players interact in an underlying game with globally verifiable productive actions and externally enforced transfers. The paper investigates whether such decentralized contracting can internalize externalities that arise due to parties being unable to contract directly with others whose productive actions affect their payoffs. The contract‐formation protocol, called the “contracting institution,” is treated as a design element. The main result is positive: There is a contracting institution that supports efficient equilibria for any underlying game and connected network. A critical property is that the institution allows for sequential contract formation or revision. The equilibrium construction features assurance contracts and cancellation penalties.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文发展了一个私人双边合同模型，其中外生网络决定了哪些玩家之间可以沟通和签订合同。在签订合同后，玩家在一个基础博弈中互动，该博弈具有全局可验证的生产行动和外部执行的转移支付。本文研究了这种分散化合同能否内化由于各方无法直接与那些其生产行动影响其收益的其他人签订合同而产生的外部性。合同形成协议，称为“合同制度”，被视为设计元素。主要结果是积极的：存在一种合同制度，能够为任何基础博弈和连通网络支持有效均衡。一个关键特性是该制度允许顺序合同形成或修订。均衡构建具有保证合同和取消罚金的特点。
